8.7.7.2. iLock_Geography.geo_algorithms.pathiter.SwitchIter.cond¶

SwitchIter.cond(inIndex, obj, outIndex)¶
This function determines if obj will be iterated, depending on
  1. if obj is a switch,
  2. which leg of obj is traversed by path and
  3. whether it is a facing and trailing switch.
Parameters:
  • inIndex (int | none) – The index that connects to the edge entering the node containing obj.
  • obj (IRailyardComponent) – The object whose type is checked.
  • outIndex (int | none) – The index that connects to the edge leaving the node containing obj.
Return type:

bool
Returns:

Return True if obj is a switch whose traveling leg and direction in path are consistent with diverging and facing.
